title: Kraken-backed xStocks launches on TON Wallet in ‘nearly all markets’
summary: The rollout provides Telegram users with access to tokenized US stocks via a self-custodial wallet, but it will not be available in the US at launch.

title: Bitcoiners push for quantum-resistant BIP-360 upgrade as debate heats up
summary: Bitcoin’s Taproot usage is declining, signaling wider concerns around its quantum future, as the leading cryptographers race to solve the quantum threat in 2026.

title: ETHGas raises $12M as Buterin spotlights onchain gas futures
summary: Ethereum blockspace trading platform ETHGas announced a $12 million raise shortly after ETH co-founder Vitalik Buterin endorsed the idea, promising 50ms transaction times.

title: Coinbase expands in Poland with Blik mobile payments integration
summary: Coinbase expands in Poland with PPro to support Blik, making crypto transactions faster and easier amid stalled local regulations.

title: Tokenized stocks may be onchain, but the SEC still wants the keys
summary: The US Securities and Exchange Commission outlined how tokenized equities can exist inside US market safeguards, favoring broker-led custody over crypto-native self-custody.

title: XRP’s ‘bearish’ setup may crash price below $1: Analyst
summary: XRP looked increasingly bearish below $2, with multiple indicators suggesting that a downward move toward $1 was possible in the coming weeks.

title: Spot Bitcoin ETFs record $450M inflows in ‘early positioning’ push
summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs logged their strongest inflows in over a month amid renewed institutional demand tied to shifting macro expectations.

title: Ethereum needs simple explanation to see true trustlessness: Buterin
summary: Vitalik Buterin says Ethereum needs to boost the number of people who can understand the entire blockchain, and it can “get better at this by making the protocol simpler.”

title: MSCI’s crypto treasury rules could spur $15B of forced selling
summary: Analysts estimated that crypto treasury firms face up to $11.6 billion in outflows if MSCI excluded them from its indexes.

title: Crypto ETPs could see a flood of liquidations by 2027: Analyst
summary: Many of the crypto ETP applications awaiting SEC approval will launch in 2026, but a lot of those won’t survive beyond 2027, says Bloomberg analyst James Seyffart.
